$comment: Nominal, field-of-view-derived camera geometry for the LOOKOUT starter.
These are not measured per-camera calibrations. For released data, the public manifest supplies the per-clip active image and calibration.
Thermal video may be pillarboxed; focal lengths use the active image dimensions, not the encoded container width.

wide.notes: Nominal 55.3 degree horizontal field of view at 1920 pixels.

zoom.notes: Nominal 28 degree horizontal field of view at 1920 pixels.

flir-VIS.notes: Visible channel. Horizontal and vertical focal lengths differ after image scaling; this preset is not pillarboxed.

flir-IR.fy: per-clip (from 18 deg VFOV over active rows, ~3409)
flir-IR.notes: Thermal channel. Use each clip active image rectangle. Derive fx from the 24 degree horizontal field of view and fy separately from the 18 degree vertical field of view.

distortion.notes: No distortion coefficients are available for any preset. The baseline runs a pinhole model with zero distortion. Estimating distortion is left to challenge participants.

principal_point.notes: Nominal image centre; for pillarboxed clips use the centre of the active image.
